scope: Strict full-text audit of the 14 exact-title OpenAlex resolutions whose download-audit status is downloaded. Evidence is limited to scripts/data/paper-dataset-audits/paper-fulltext-resolutions.json, tmp/pdfs/openalex-exact/download-audit.json, and the corresponding local PDF text extractions. No website or scripts/data file was edited.

decisionPolicy.approve: Approve only a named public dataset explicitly used by the audited paper to train, pre-train, fine-tune, optimize a learned component, or demonstrate model training.
decisionPolicy.reject: Reject evaluation/test/benchmark-only assets, reward-only use, simulation environments and task suites, methods/models, private or unreleased constructed data, human-study measurements not used for model fitting, and survey or background mentions of other work.
decisionPolicy.linkPolicy: Include a URL only when the exact dataset or processed-data URL is printed in the local full text. Do not infer a landing page or repository from a dataset name or paper identity.

paper.title: MetaWave: Attacking mmWave Sensing with Meta-material-enhanced Tags

rejected.nameMatchReason: The evaluation explicitly describes acquiring 60-second COTS mmWave radar signals for each trial.
rejected.reason: The collected signals measure whether optimized physical tags spoof sensing results. They are neither used to fit a learned model nor released as a named public dataset.

evidence.evidence: The authors collect COTS radar signals across 20 environments for evaluation, while the attack parameters are optimized by a physics simulator and gradient descent.

paper.title: Paralyzing Drones via EMI Signal Injection on Sensory Communication Channels

evidence.evidence: The work experimentally identifies susceptible frequencies and evaluates their effect with PX4 simulations and physical drones.

paper.title: Un-Rocking Drones: Foundations of Acoustic Injection Attacks and Recovery Thereof

evidence.evidence: After training the models, the paper evaluates them on actual flight data and actual sensor injection; the appendix also describes a separate additional test dataset.

paper.title: Crowd-GPS-Sec: Leveraging Crowdsourcing to Detect and Localize GPS Spoofing Attacks
